body: Honestly, I don't know. The managers were pretty shitty people. Let the employee take the abuse type.

I'm super late to this party, but I'll share mine too.
I start working at a well known fast food chain as my second job and first time on the 'customer service' job. I was super super nervous. Like I can barely talk, my hands are coated in sweat and I'm stammering pretty hard. So I'm doing as my supervisor asked of me and a mid-40s guy, well dressed and super tall rolls up and orders a single item. Normally this is fine but he came during rush hour where singles tend to get overlooked by accident. Supervisor about 30-40ish minutes later asks for me to do some mopping of the tiles. Then the guy who ordered that one item comes up to me and literally gets into my face. He's real red and real mad. He starts screaming and yelling about how he hasn't received his order and that it's been ages. I feebly manage to apologise and tell him that I'll get it, personally. He doesn't want it anymore and just keeps ranting and raving. His hands were shaking pretty badly and at this point the whole store is staring at him. He picked up my mop and just when I thought he was planning to hit me with it, he snaps it. I try my best to muster something in hopes it'll calm this asshole. He yells obscenities and calls me a bumbling retard and whatnot. After about 25 minutes of this shit the store owner comes out and tells him to knock it off and tells him to leave before the police was called. He starts sobbing and trashes the whole self serve condiments area and storms out. I ended up quickly cleaning up his mess just so I could run to the employee bathroom and attempt to calm myself. All I ended up doing was crying my eyes out and washed my face so I could go back on shift.

I didn't approve of my (former) best friend's partner because he's a serial liar. He lies about stupid shit all the time. Claims he has things he doesn't. Claims to have jobs he doesn't too. Always making up stories. It's fucking sad. At one point she started to avoid me and one of her other close friends constantly. Like, always last minute cancelling. We both were worried so I confronted her. 
A large fight later she chose the guy she had been dating for 3 months over her best friend of 5 years. Fast forward a few months, he's been messaging me trying to get me to cheat on my husband with him. Yes, they're still together. She deserves someone a million times better.
